dialogues.speaker: Araminali
dialogues.text: #Nara {NICKNAME} wants to open the "treasure chests"? But... There are still a lot of Aranara in need in Vana, if the Golden Nara can help these Aranara...

dialogues.speaker: Araminali
dialogues.text: Araminali will fill the "treasure chests" with treasure! Together with the "good stuff" sent back by Aranimba, the "treasure chests" will be filled with good stuff.

dialogues.speaker: Araminali
dialogues.text: #Araminali knows the Golden Nara is a good Nara who helped Aranara. So Araminali's "treasure chests" are for Nara {NICKNAME}.

dialogues.speaker: Araminali
dialogues.text: #Araminali heard that Nara {NICKNAME} was "showing off {M#his}{F#her} skills" in Vana.

dialogues.speaker: Araminali
dialogues.text: #"Treasure" has been put in the "chest," Nara {NICKNAME} can open the "treasure chest," "you are welcome"!

dialogues.speaker: Araminali
dialogues.text: #Nara {NICKNAME}, and Paimon, hurry up! Araminali's treasure chests are ready, and Araminali has been waiting for a long time...

dialogues.speaker: Araminali
dialogues.text: Aranara's good friends. "Treasure chests" have been filled up. Time to open them!

dialogues.speaker: Araminali
dialogues.text: #Araminali has been told by many Aranara that Nara {NICKNAME} and Paimon did a lot of good things...

dialogues.speaker: Araminali
dialogues.text: Araminali already knew it. Those praise words, running through the branches of the forest, wading through the trickle, along with the breeze, are blown into the "happy nest" of Araminali!

dialogues.speaker: Araminali
dialogues.text: #So this time, Araminali filled the "chests" up and wait for Nara {NICKNAME} to open.

dialogues.speaker: Araminali
dialogues.text: #The sparkling things brought back by Aranimba were also stuffed in the "chests." Maybe Nara {NICKNAME} will like them?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Didn't Aranimba come back?

dialogues.speaker: Araminali
dialogues.text: Well, unlike a big tree with a deep root. Aranimba is the kind of Aranara who doesn't stop.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Eh... Won't Araminali be lonely here?

dialogues.speaker: Araminali
dialogues.text: What does "lonely" mean?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Um... That is, when you are alone, you really want to have someone around you?

dialogues.speaker: Araminali
dialogues.text: There are many Aranara in Vanarana so Araminali is not "lonely" at all.

dialogues.speaker: Araminali
dialogues.text: With that being said, Arayama and Aranimba are no longer in Vanarana. These three Aranara used to stick together, and they were so happy no matter what they did.

dialogues.speaker: Araminali
dialogues.text: Arayama's Ararakalari is very strong. Weak Nara can do nothing about it. Aranimba is very good at painting, all kinds of things, all look good.

dialogues.speaker: Araminali
dialogues.text: But now, there are only Araminali and his "treasure chests."

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Araminali...

dialogues.speaker: Araminali
dialogues.text: It's fine. Araminali has many "treasure chests," although Araminali doesn't know why Nara likes opening chests...

dialogues.speaker: Araminali
dialogues.text: But Araminali is the owner of the "treasure chests." Nara, who likes treasure chests, also likes Araminali, right?

dialogues.speaker: Araminali
dialogues.text: However, Araminali has no more "treasures" left, um... the "chests" will be empty for a while.

dialogues.speaker: Araminali
dialogues.text: #Though Araminali's "treasure chests" are about to be empty, Nara {NICKNAME} will still be Aranara's good friend, no?

dialogues.speaker: Araminali
dialogues.text: #Araminali is not ready! The "treasure chests" are still hungry. Nara {NICKNAME} and Paimon can "lazy about"...

dialogues.speaker: Araminali
dialogues.text: #Hmm, no, not right. Nara {NICKNAME} and Paimon can "roam around." That way, might run into Aranara in need of help.

dialogues.speaker: Araminali
dialogues.text: #Araminali has a full belly. "Treasure chests" are still hungry. Hungry is not good. Nara {NICKNAME} and Paimon walk everywhere, must be very hungry. Nara {NICKNAME} and Paimon must eat a lot of mushrooms to gain energy.
